content.comment_body: Hello. I'm seeing a dotted line between these two [product_name] modules, but I'm not sure what I'm doing wrong. The expected blue line isn't showing between the server and client modules, although the network identified them automatically. I just got it working by clicking the gear icon on the [product_name] modules and enabling the appropriate communication protocol (Profibus or [version_no]). That solved the issue.

You have two [product_name] modules running [version_no]. In this version, there's a new requirement to allow access for [version_no] connections, and this needs to be configured on both modules. Go to File > Properties to enable this setting.
